item.title: Sunday 10 AM Update, Oct 18
item.description:
The Sunday 10 AM update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 18, 2026: a record-low approval rating for President Trump in the new Post-ABC-Ipsos poll, Vice President Vance's tough CBS town hall in Michigan, a New York Times report that U.S. envoys pitched Europe on Russian gas, Iran's new defense minister, Pakistan's sudden halt to trade with Iran, a deadly resort fire in Bangladesh, Microsoft walking away from a flagship British A.I. data center, Mercedes-AMG's electric GT SUV, a Codex usage-limit mess and Google's open-source Harness squared, phishing emails aimed at your A.I. assistant and a coffee chain's vibe-coded leak, your X feed with D.H.H. in Shenzhen and an iPhone video glitch, a Whitey Bulger breakfast and an opera-inspired concert around Andover, and the chain of strangers who saved a great horned owl. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Sunday Morning, Oct 18
item.description:
The Sunday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for October 18, 2026: Reuters reports President Trump is blaming aides as Republican midterm hopes dim, the A.P. tallies what the Iran war is costing households, a deadly explosion and fire at Canada's Wainwright military base, Ukraine's thousand-drone strike on St. Petersburg, Iran's offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, the morning after France's riots, the fight over A.I. pricing in stores, OpenAI's free plan for university labs and new ChatGPT voices, a huge California student data breach and Florida's driver database notices, your X feed with Taylor Swift and a fruit fly in a virtual world, the Walk to End Alzheimer's and early voting in Andover, and a Rhode Island grower's record three-thousand-pound pumpkin. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Saturday 1 PM Update, Oct 17
item.description:
The Saturday one o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 17, 2026: President Trump threatens California election officials with jail over disputed mail ballots, Rep. Ilhan Omar's lawyers push back on the search of her home, nationwide early-voting rallies, masked settlers attack European diplomats in the West Bank, Egypt's president seeks authority to help defend Saudi Arabia, a green light for the pope's Latin America trip, France and Germany's deal to soften Europe's 2035 car rules, a Honda redo recall, Anthropic's draft A.I. safety bill and its critics, a supply-chain attack on Microsoft 365 through ConnectWise, your X feed, a Sunday on the Seacoast, and a blind spaniel named Hero who learned to see with his nose. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
